elements.manual_reason: No candidate box isolates the cursor; it moves from the Goal cell down into the option list and settles left of 'Delight users'.
elements.label: Mouse cursor

pattern.description: A click on the empty Goal cell of the new idea opens a select dropdown (search field plus goal options) at once; the cursor then glides down through the options, hover highlights following it, toward 'Delight users'.
pattern.why_premium: A real interaction played back cleanly and timed to the narration ('every idea has fields'): the dropdown snaps open and the hover states lead the eye to the option about to be picked.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.goal-cell', {text: 'Select...'}).fromTo('.goal-dropdown', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.05}).to('.cursor', {x: 336, y: 342, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); toggle .option.is-hover on each row as the cursor crosses it (no tween).
build_hint.remotion: Mount the dropdown at the click frame (opacity 0->1 over 1-2 frames); interpolate cursor x/y over ~15 frames with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad); compute the hovered option from the cursor y each frame and apply the hover background.

notes: Dropdown appears within one frame (f271->f272), so it is effectively a cut-on UI state, not a tween. b09 ('Win large customers') is static and partly hidden by the box overlay, so it was not listed. No SFX candidates.
